triplets.tail: Bruising (dark spots on beak/nails), prolonged bleeding from minor injuries, lethargy

triplets.head: Salt (excess)
triplets.tail: Sodium chloride (excess sodium)

triplets.tail: Sodium toxicosis / hypernatremia — electrolyte imbalance, kidney dysfunction, neurological damage

triplets.head: Salt (excess)
triplets.tail: Symptoms within hours of large ingestion

triplets.head: Salt (excess)
triplets.tail: Excessive thirst, increased urination, wet droppings

triplets.head: Salt (excess)
triplets.tail: Leg paralysis, seizures, fluid discharge from beak, kidney failure, death

triplets.head: High-fat foods
triplets.tail: Excess saturated fats

triplets.head: High-fat foods
triplets.tail: Fatty liver disease (hepatic lipidosis), obesity, atherosclerosis, heart disease

triplets.head: High-fat foods
triplets.tail: Chronic — weeks to months to years

triplets.head: High-fat foods
triplets.tail: Gradual weight gain, reduced activity, overgrown beak

triplets.head: High-fat foods
triplets.tail: Yellow or green urates, swollen/distended abdomen, difficulty breathing, collapse; in Bourke's may appear normal externally then die suddenly

triplets.head: High-sugar foods
triplets.tail: Excess simple sugars

triplets.head: High-sugar foods
triplets.tail: Yeast/fungal overgrowth in crop (candidiasis), obesity, nutritional imbalance

triplets.head: Dairy products
triplets.tail: Lactose — birds lack sufficient lactase enzyme

triplets.head: Dairy products
triplets.tail: Digestive upset, diarrhea, dehydration

triplets.head: Moldy food (peanuts, corn, old seeds)
triplets.tail: Aflatoxins (produced by Aspergillus flavus and A. parasiticus fungi)

triplets.head: Moldy food (peanuts, corn, old seeds)
triplets.tail: Aflatoxicosis (acute liver necrosis) and/or aspergillosis (fungal respiratory infection)

triplets.head: Moldy food (peanuts, corn, old seeds)
triplets.tail: Sluggishness, loss of appetite, vomiting, jaundice, diarrhea

triplets.head: Moldy food (peanuts, corn, old seeds)
triplets.tail: Progressive breathing difficulty, tail bobbing, voice change/loss, wheezing, weight loss, nasal discharge

triplets.head: Moldy food (peanuts, corn, old seeds)

triplets.head: Sulfited dried fruit
triplets.tail: Sulfur dioxide / sulfites (SO₂, sodium sulfite, sodium bisulfite)

triplets.head: Sulfited dried fruit
triplets.tail: Respiratory irritation / sulfite sensitivity — birds' sensitive air sac system is especially vulnerable

triplets.head: Sulfited dried fruit
triplets.tail: Wheezing, labored breathing, tail bobbing, nasal discharge, coughing, lethargy

triplets.head: Sulfited dried fruit
triplets.tail: Always buy unsulfured dried fruit; look for 'no sulfites added' on label

triplets.head: Nightshade plant parts (tomato/potato/eggplant leaves, stems, green parts)

triplets.head: Nightshade plant parts (tomato/potato/eggplant leaves, stems, green parts)

triplets.head: Nightshade plant parts (tomato/potato/eggplant leaves, stems, green parts)

triplets.head: Raw egg white
triplets.tail: Poor feather quality, scaly skin, foot lesions, weakness, reduced appetite

triplets.head: Raw egg white
triplets.tail: Cooked egg is safe and nutritious — heat denatures avidin

triplets.tail: PTFE decomposes into carbonyl fluoride, hydrogen fluoride, perfluoroisobutylene when heated above 280°C

triplets.tail: PTFE toxicosis — acute pulmonary edema, hemorrhage, cardiac failure

triplets.head: Teflon/PTFE fumes
triplets.tail: MINUTES — often instant death; birds may die before symptoms are noticed

triplets.head: Teflon/PTFE fumes
triplets.tail: Sudden severe respiratory distress, open-mouth gasping, falling from perch, incoordination, seizures

triplets.head: Teflon/PTFE fumes

triplets.head: Teflon/PTFE fumes

triplets.head: Grit
triplets.tail: Crop impaction / gizzard impaction

triplets.tail: Various volatile organic compounds, synthetic fragrances

triplets.tail: Respiratory irritation, distress, failure — birds' air sac respiratory system absorbs chemicals far more efficiently than mammal lungs

triplets.tail: Neurotoxicity — causes vomiting, coma, death

triplets.head: Oral medication for food poisoning in parrots
triplets.tail: All psittacine (parrot) species can receive oral medication; no small parrot species is excluded

triplets.head: Oral medication for food poisoning in parrots
triplets.tail: Activated charcoal (1–3 g/kg orally), oral chelating agents (DMSA, D-penicillamine), oral vitamin K1, oral antibiotics — all adjusted by body weight

triplets.head: Oral medication for food poisoning in parrots
triplets.tail: Oral medication contraindicated if bird is actively seizing, laterally recumbent, regurgitating, in shock, or has GI stasis — injectable medications used instead

triplets.head: Oral medication for food poisoning in parrots
triplets.tail: Almost all avian medications are off-label; dosing is extremely weight-sensitive (a 30g budgie requires fractions of a milliliter); wrong dose can be instantly fatal; aspiration pneumonia risk if administered incorrectly
